basis: Congenital atrial septal defect with cardiovascular shunting and anomalous pulmonary venous return; dyspnea does not establish lung damage.
Mitochondrial myopathy with external ophthalmoplegia; cerebellar atrophy in 2/4 supports neurologic involvement. Dysphagia reflects neuromuscular dysfunction.
ADHD is a neurodevelopmental disorder, explicitly covered by the neurologic axis.
Congenital absence or severe shortening of limb bones defines this skeletal malformation.
Oxidative phosphorylation defect; developmental delay 5/6, contractures 3/6 and kyphoscoliosis 2/6, strabismus 2/6. Dysphagia/constipation do not establish direct gut damage.
Subaortic stenosis and short stature define the syndrome; scoliosis/kyphosis occur in 30-79%. Vocal cord malformation in 80-99% supports airway involvement.
Inherited beta-globin production disorder causing microcytic anemia; skeletal and iron-overload damage do not apply across the major, intermedia and minor forms.
Opisthorchis flukes occupy and inflame the biliary tract. Cholangiocarcinoma is a later risk, not an involved organ.
Obstruction of kidneys or urinary drainage structures lies within the renal axis.
Lateral cystocele is prolapse of the urinary bladder through defective lateral vaginal support; the affected bladder belongs to the renal axis.
Joubert brain malformation and neurodevelopmental dysfunction; ocular-defect parent with pigmentary retinopathy and optic disc pallor in 1/2.
Obliterative disease of the small airways; non-transplant status does not establish a universal infectious or immune mechanism.
Loss of gastric hydrochloric acid secretion is a stomach functional disorder; an autoimmune cause is not inherent to this umbrella concept.
Syndromic developmental impairment with characteristic hand, digit and skeletal abnormalities. Cardiomyopathy is occasional; reflux is a separate associated disorder.
Glycinergic startle disorder; rigidity and stiffness are neurologic. Associated reflux/esophagitis is separately diagnosed and does not establish direct gut involvement.
Congenital ventricular wall diverticulum; extracardiac structural abnormalities are occasional, below 30%.
Thyroid underdevelopment causes congenital hypothyroidism; developmental delay and severe intellectual disability are frequent (30-79%). Definition overrides discordant ancestry.
Usher syndrome defines auditory/vestibular and retinal dysfunction, present in 5/5; left ventricular hypertrophy is reported in 2/5, supporting cardiac involvement.
Glycosylation defect; severe neurologic impairment 2/2, joint contractures 2/2, visual impairment 2/2 with optic atrophy 1/2. Isolated GGT elevation is insufficient for hepatic damage.
Eyebrow duplication and hair/skin abnormalities accompany defining syndactyly of fingers and toes; eyebrows belong to skin, not the ocular axis.
Intellectual developmental impairment, dyskinesia and seizures define a neurologic disorder; hypotonia and abnormal movements do not establish primary muscle disease.
The defining nail, skin pigmentation and hair abnormalities all lie within the dermatologic axis; acanthosis-like lesions do not establish endocrine disease.
Dental root dysplasia and taurodontia affect teeth, explicitly covered by the gastrointestinal axis; no independent skeletal disease is established.
GJA3-related nonsyndromic cataract is a lens disorder without established extraocular involvement.
Immune-mediated hypersensitivity inflammation directly affects lung parenchyma and small airways, including in the non-fibrotic form.
